assets.name: snake-head
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready game sprite for a 2D grid-based gravity snake game, genuine transparent alpha background. One isolated object, no scenery, no ground plane, no text, no labels, no watermark, no extra objects. Hand-sculpted matte clay / soft rubber, subtle organic surface grain, broad rounded bevels, crisp controlled lighting from upper left and shaded lower-right edges. Polished game art, readable at 30 pixels. Orthographic frontal/top view appropriate for a flat 2D grid, NOT isometric. Square canvas 1024x1024. Object centered, occupies 90 percent of canvas. A lime green rounded-square snake head viewed from above, facing RIGHT. A thick rounded cuboid with smooth green skin, subtle scale-like dimples. Two ivory eyes with round black pupils on the right half arranged vertically, looking right. A small friendly but focused mouth at the right edge, no tongue. The head must be essentially a square segment, fit cleanly into a 2D tile grid. No body, neck, legs or accessories.
assets.status: retired: replaced by snake-body.png plus independently drawn SVG eyes; original kept only in gitignored production/audio-reference/retired-art/
